name: Launch Library 2
tagline: Global space launch schedule and event data API from The Space Devs
description: Launch Library 2 provides comprehensive, community-maintained data on space launches, spacecraft, agencies, and related events worldwide. It is the public REST API for The Space Devs project and is widely used for launch schedules, countdowns, and aerospace research integrations.

auth.details: No authentication required for free tier; optional API token for higher rate limits via Authorization header after free signup

use_cases: get details for a specific launch by ID
search launches by rocket or agency
track launch status and NET times
